title: Breach the Walls
description: Ser Aldous Marrow has lost six families off his tenant land since the bandits fortified the hills above Willow Dale. His own guards tried the stronghold once and came back three men short. He's paying our siege rate.

objectives.description: Reach the stronghold that's emptied Marrow's land
Break the outer defenses before pushing in
Clear the inner keep, captain by captain
Bring down the commander who built the stronghold
Report the stronghold's fall so Marrow's tenants can go back

notes: Threat: six tenant families driven off Marrow's land near Willow Dale, invented client, no bible basis. Giver motive: Marrow's own guards already failed here and lost men - this is why he pays for professionals instead of doing it himself. Consequence: unwired - the land stays empty if the stronghold isn't taken, no flag records it either way.
